description: N50 Kartdata is the topographic map data of Kartverket, the Norwegian Mapping Authority, for scales from 1:25,000 to 1:100,000. According to its Geonorge catalogue entry, its content matches the Norway 1:50,000 paper map series except for bathymetry, and its themes are land cover (water, land types and similar), administrative areas, buildings and installations, elevation, restricted areas, transport (samferdsel) and place names. Coverage: mainland Norway, bounded by the national border and the territorial limit at sea; cartographically edited for display at 1:50,000. Format and access: downloaded through the Geonorge download service in FGDB, GML, PostGIS and SOSI formats, in EUREF89 UTM zones 32, 33 and 35; a Topografisk Norgeskart WMS shows it; product specification and product sheet are on the Geonorge register. The dataset is updated continuously and distributed weekly; the catalogue entry was last updated on 26 September 2026. Free. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (open data, no access limitations). Caveats: generalised for 1:50,000 cartography, so positions and attributes are coarser than the detailed FKB data; the product specification, which lists the object types in the transport and buildings themes, was not read. Simulation uses: national road, rail and building layers for Norway in exposure and accessibility studies at regional scale. Related records: the Norwegian national road database (data-norway-nvdb-national-road-database) holds the detailed road network, and the cadastre building points (data-norway-matrikkelen-building-points) the buildings.
